history.text: Ted Turner bought Jim Crockett Promotions, which became World Championship Wrestling, and the title was renamed.
The NWA recognized its own world tag team title for the first time after a tournament won by Terry Gordy and Steve Williams.
Both titles were defended together until WCW left the NWA in September 1993.
The WWF purchased WCW, and the title became one of two WWF tag team titles, abbreviated to WCW Tag Team Championship.
Kane and The Undertaker unified both titles in a steel cage match at SummerSlam, the first time they were unified.
At Survivor Series, The Dudley Boyz beat The Hardy Boyz in a steel cage unification match, and the WCW Tag Team Championship was retired.
The NWA withdrew recognition of WCW World Tag Team Champions linked to the NWA World Tag Team Championship, stating their titles were formed in 1995.
